summary: A BUSINESSMAN walks along the sidewalk wheeling and dealing into his cell phone when Neo flashes by and snatches it. The Man cries out in shock, "What the shit-- my phone!" and turns to call for help, but when he turns back he has become Agent Smith. Meanwhile Neo is in a full-out sprint, spinning and weaving away from every pedestrian and potential Agent, then flips open the stolen cell phone and dials long distance.

what_changes.before: The BUSINESSMAN is wheeling and dealing into his own cell phone.
what_changes.after: Neo snatches the phone and carries it off, dialing long distance.
what_changes.evidence: wheeling and dealing into his cell phone when it disappears, snatched by Neo as he flashes by.

what_changes.before: A startled civilian crying out, "What the shit-- my phone!"
what_changes.after: He has transformed into Agent Smith.
what_changes.evidence: The Man turns to call for help and when he turns back, it is Agent Smith.

event_hint.one_line: Neo sprints through the city with a stolen phone while being hunted, as Smith reappears in a new body.

uncertain: Whether Neo is aware that the Businessman has become Agent Smith.
Whom Neo is dialing long distance, or why.
